statement: For every based continuous path in the three-dimensional positive scalar homothety group, all exponential fractions of its endpoint are words of length at most 1913 in path values and inverses. The exact bound, together with the C37 two-dimensional bound, extends the C36/C49 closure contractions to the closure of the union of all dimension-two proper-operator orbits and all open orbits with at least three actual boundary-quotient foliations. The resulting based contraction and its inverse are jointly continuous and commute with the original operator group, including arbitrary orbit accumulation.
depends_on: C29 exact circle winding comparison; C36-C37 source-cover fractional powers, planar path identity, and metabelian limit images; C49 actual Lie closure actions; Grandoni-Ravi-Singh-Zenklusen Theorem 4.7 and the corrected interval count in its halving proof; explicit noncommutative homothety product correction; compact finite-word isotopies and residual logarithm bounds
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; uniform frontier control for the actual three-quotient Lie reductions
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The three-dimensional additive signed-measure identity is used only to form a product with exact logarithmic scale. All translation errors caused by noncommutativity, including inverse letters, are then corrected by explicit bounded powers of planar commutator paths.
notes: A maximizing path value or its inverse is a one-letter anchor with positive logarithmic scale A. After a coordinate conjugacy, its commutator with the path is the translation (e^A-1)v_s. For A at least log 2, planar fractional commutators give a 25-letter construction. For 0<A<=log 2, the three-measure identity uses at most five signed path values; its product error has five coefficients bounded by 31 times e^A-1, while the exponential interpolation correction has coefficient bounded by 4 times e^A-1, including zero endpoint scale. The exact total is 5+12(4+5*31)=1913. A=0 is the planar translation case. Compactness uses all words of that fixed length, so no continuous choice of anchor, conjugacy, or measure cuts is needed. The bounded residual equality is retained in the specified simply connected source group; two-point winding passes its real circle angle to the limit. The result extends the actual boundary prescriptions on the closed set X_star, but does not supply the remaining relative extension through one/two-foliation regions.
